WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
),
filtered_stores AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk AS s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County'
),
filtered_households AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk AS hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND hd_dep_count >= 2 * hd_vehicle_count
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number,
           ss_customer_sk AS ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_stores ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = filtered_stores.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_households ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = filtered_households.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
)
SELECT c_last_name AS c_last_name,
       c_first_name AS c_first_name,
       c_salutation AS c_salutation,
       c_preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
       ss_ticket_number,
       cnt
FROM sales_agg
INNER JOIN customer ON sales_agg.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c_last_name ASC
